raw.cause: camera was destroyed at 3274.8 ms (91117). On display's next tick, its synchronous MsgSend() to camera on coid 0x40000002 failed because the server was gone. In the unfixed build, run_display() treats that -1 as fatal ("camera failed, giving up", return 1), so display exited 30 ms later (95162) even though nav and logger were still available. That breaks the isolation contract.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in display (to camera, error return treated as fatal in run_display)
raw.fix_summary: Do not let a camera MsgSend failure end the display loop. Either run with COCKPIT_FIXED=1, where a separate camera_reader thread talks to camera and the main loop only reads last_frame, or make the inline path degrade: on -1, close the connection, show "camera stale", and keep drawing (optionally retrying name_open later). The reader thread is the better fix, because it also covers a camera that hangs instead of dying.
